    $1::text[], $2::text, $3::float8, $4::float8,
    $5::integer)

WITH outcomes AS (
    SELECT * FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::uuid[], $3::text[], $4::text[])
        AS c(id, token, kind, data)
), applied AS (
UPDATE fronta.tasks t SET
    state = CASE c.kind
        WHEN $5 THEN $6
        WHEN $7 THEN $8
        WHEN $9 THEN $10
        WHEN $11 THEN CASE WHEN t.cancel_requested_at IS NULL THEN $12 ELSE $13 END
        WHEN $14 THEN CASE WHEN t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN $15
            WHEN t.failures + $16 < t.max_attempts THEN $17 ELSE $18 END END,
    result = CASE WHEN c.kind = $19 THEN c.data::jsonb ELSE t.result END,
    error = CASE WHEN c.kind IN ($20 /*, ... */) THEN c.data::jsonb ELSE t.error END,
    failures = t.failures + CASE WHEN c.kind IN ($21 /*, ... */) THEN $22 ELSE $23 END,
    run_at = CASE WHEN c.kind = $24 THEN now()
        WHEN c.kind = $25 AND t.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND t.failures + $26 < t.max_attempts
        THEN now() + make_interval(secs => least(t.backoff_cap_s, t.backoff_base_s * power(t.backoff_factor, least(t.failures, $27))) * ($28 + $29 * random())) ELSE t.run_at END,
    finished_at = CASE WHEN c.kind IN ($30 /*, ... */)
        OR t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR (c.kind = $31 AND t.failures + $32 >= t.max_attempts)
        THEN now() END,
    token = $33, lease_until = $34
FROM outcomes c WHERE t.id = c.id AND t.state = $35 AND t.token = c.token
    AND (c.kind <> $36 OR t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL)
RETURNING t.id, t.type, t.state, t.attempt
), published AS (
INSERT INTO fronta.events (subscription, task_id, type, state, attempt)
SELECT s.name, a.id, a.type, a.state, a.attempt
FROM applied a JOIN fronta.subscriptions s
  ON a.state = ANY(s.states) AND (s.types IS NULL OR a.type = ANY(s.types))
)
SELECT id, type, state FROM applied
